newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia says 65 people died in gutted complex.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia says 65 people died in gutted complex.

text.p: The bodies of 65 people have been found in a gutted shopping complex following riots in the South Kalimantan provincial capital of Banjarmasin, Indonesian armed forces spokesman Brigadier-General Slamet Supriadi said on Sunday.
"Our preliminary investigation...says that 65 have been found dead on the second floor," he told Reuters.
He said 181 people had been arrested following the riots which erupted on Friday on the last day of Indonesia's general election campaign. He gave no other details.
A local resident told Reuters earlier those who died were apparently trapped when flames swept through the complex after dark following looting. It was not known how the fire started.
The violence erupted following clashes between supporters of the ruling Golkar party campaigning in the city and angry crowds emerging from mosques after Friday prayers.
